windows.label: Human
windows.text: Take 5g a day as a baseline. The point of that baseline is to counter the breakdown of the gut lining that high-intensity or high-volume training causes, like CrossFit or intense cardio.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: If your immune system is dealing with an acute exposure, if your whole system is under a lot of stress, or if you have active IBD (Crohn's or colitis), raise it gradually to 10-30g a day.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: CAUTION: cancer cells that multiply really fast can grab glutamine too, to fuel their growth.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: So if you have an active colon or liver cancer, don't raise the dose that high.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: The liver is on that list because the blood from your gut goes straight there, through the portal vein, so a big dose of glutamine reaches your liver before anywhere else.
